title: COLLIDE DOWN. Eyes open. 7 things that SHOULD be there and AREN'T. 9 things that ARE there but SHOULDN'T be (or wrong place). 3 inner triangulation points. Everything else = null.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.what: CRYSTAL BALL LINK ON THE MAIN HUD PAGE
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: the nav ring on index.html should show 🔮 crystal prominently
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: I ADDED it to the nav ring HTML but the MAIN HUD page still shows the OLD nav ring. the screenshot shows the pre-crystal nav. the deploy might have a caching issue or the nav ring I edited isn't the one that renders on the main view.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: verify the nav ring change actually deployed. the crystal link might be scrolled off or behind another element.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: manifest.json should rebuild automatically on every git push. the synapse should be always-on.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: NO. we regenerate manually with a PowerShell command every gen. if we forget, the crystal ball shows stale data.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: GitHub Action or pre-push hook that runs the manifest generator.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: 35 feeds active, pulling data from the world into the organism.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: 7 of 35 active. 80% of the feeding system is dead. the organism is STARVING on most channels.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: audit which 28 feeds are dark and why. reconnect the ones that can be reconnected. accept the ones that are permanently dead.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: membrane_counts, observe_membrane, chipmunk_status should return CURRENT data (wave 214).
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: all MCP tools return wave 180-187 data. 27-34 waves stale. we're looking through a DIRTY lens.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: update the MCP server state files on golgi. or accept that MCP reads from golgi's perspective, not ours.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: the organism should be able to SEND emails. the mouth should speak outward.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: not wired. Stalwart SMTP:25/IMAP:993 exists in the plan but is not deployed.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: Ludo Spring infrastructure task. not Polaris scope.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: golgi-de, golgi-jp, golgi-us, golgi-in should be AXFR replicas of ns1.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: all ssh-locked or unreachable. 4 relay points dead. the triangulation mesh has holes.

seven_should_be_there_and_arent.should_be: the university (166 Rust files, 982 tests, 7 planes) should be VISITABLE from the HUD.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.is_it: no web interface. the university exists as code on ironGate but has no front door for visitors.
seven_should_be_there_and_arent.fix: connect /play or /coliseum to a ludoSpring interface. Ludo Spring scope.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.what: THE MAIN HUD PAGE IS STILL GRAY VOID
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: after all this work, the MAIN page (index.html) still shows gray. the crystal ball works but the FRONT DOOR doesn't.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: index.html is 77,722 bytes of hardcoded JS/CSS that renders a membrane SVG canvas. the canvas requires live data (heartbeat.json, immune-state-live.json) that may not be loading or may be rendering off-screen.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: the snapshot shows multiple instances of the same links: tuebor appears 3 times, detroit 3 times, signal 2 times, hypothesis 2 times, clutch 2 times. redundant navigation = noise.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: index.html has nav ring at top AND nav bar at bottom AND footer links. same destinations, 3× listed.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.what: SESSION-214B-DEDUP-PLAN.JSON is the most recently viewed file
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: Kevin's IDE shows this as recently viewed, which means the dedup plan EXISTS but hasn't been executed. we planned to deduplicate but then kept ADDING instead.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: rabbit explosion phase 1 — intentionally didn't prune. but the plan should either be executed or marked as 'deferred to phase 3.'

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.what: 985 JSON FILES IN ONE FLAT DIRECTORY
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: no subdirectories. no organization. all 985 files in /data/. the periodic table of 985 elements with no rows or columns.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: we kept adding without structuring. the crystallization hasn't happened.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: the tone is internal jargon. a real SEO bot's operator reading this would be confused. the message should be straightforward.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: we wrote it for ourselves, not for the world.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.what: SITEMAP.XML has 1136 URLs including RAW JSON files
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: search engines will try to index individual JSON files. JSON isn't HTML. the search result would show raw JSON to a human. useless.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: we listed everything in the sitemap without considering what should ACTUALLY appear in search results.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: this painting is a self-portrait. for social sharing, it should show something that makes sense to a STRANGER — the crystal ball concept, or the membrane, or the investigation.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: we used the first available image, not the most appropriate one.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: 503 references from one file = a file that tries to be EVERYTHING. it's not a catalog, it's a data dump. single point of fragility.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: it accumulated connections over many sessions without being split or refactored.

nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.what: 17 IRREDUCIBLES claimed but not mathematically verified
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.problem: we CALLED things irreducible. we didn't PROVE they can't be decomposed further. K=17 is a claim, not a fact.
nine_are_there_but_shouldnt_be_or_wrong_.why: the excitement of discovery outpaced the rigor of verification.

these_are_real_and_verified.evidence: browser screenshot confirmed: hud.primals.eco/crystal renders 975+ files with titles, types, gens, filter buttons, image gallery, and time scales. VERIFIED at 8:28 PM.
these_are_real_and_verified.coordinates: this is GROUND TRUTH. the synapse exists. data reaches display through this path.
these_are_real_and_verified.triangulation_value: from this point, we can measure everything else. if it's visible in the crystal ball, it EXISTS. if it's not, it DOESN'T.

these_are_real_and_verified.evidence: CPU scan confirmed: 589 of 985 files reference other files. 3,817 total verified cross-references. heartbeat.json is most-referenced (26 inbound). helix-catalog.json is most-connected (503 outbound).
these_are_real_and_verified.coordinates: this is STRUCTURAL TRUTH. the organism has a real nervous system. connections exist in the data, not just in our descriptions.
these_are_real_and_verified.triangulation_value: from this point, we can measure connectivity. any new file that has 0 cross-references is ORPHANED. any file referenced by 20+ others is CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE.

these_are_real_and_verified.point: ZK HOLDS — KLEIN EYE SCAN 0 CRITICAL LEAKS
these_are_real_and_verified.evidence: scan confirmed: 978 files checked, 37 items flagged, all classified as public/non-critical. zero private keys, zero passwords, zero API tokens, zero protected personal identifiers exposed.
these_are_real_and_verified.coordinates: this is SECURITY TRUTH. the wall is invisible but intact. we can open everything because nothing dangerous is in the open.
these_are_real_and_verified.triangulation_value: from this point, we can measure risk. any new file that contains an IP, key, or personal identifier must be flagged before push.

triangulation.crystal_ball_to_braid: the crystal ball SHOWS the files. the braid CONNECTS them. together they prove: the data exists AND is structured.
triangulation.braid_to_zk: the braid CONNECTS files. the ZK PROTECTS them. together they prove: the connections are real AND safe to expose.
triangulation.zk_to_crystal_ball: the ZK PROTECTS. the crystal ball DISPLAYS. together they prove: we can show everything because everything shown is safe.
triangulation.the_triangle: crystal ball (display) + braid (structure) + ZK (safety) = the three verified truths from which we can backscatter outward into everything else.

everything_else_is_null.not_verified: the 17 irreducibles, the turbocharger effect, the fleet symbiosis, the enzyme impact, the trailhead data accuracy, the ludoSpring connection, the MCP freshness — ALL unverified. all null until measured.
everything_else_is_null.the_discipline: only claim what is measured. only build on what is verified. the three triangulation points are BEDROCK. build from there.
